title: External validation and application of machine learning models for obesity in Chinese children and adolescents per Chinese and WHO growth standards.
summary: Four supervised models used routine anthropometric and demographic predictors to classify childhood obesity under Chinese and WHO growth standards. The study included an independent Tangshan external cohort; this supports prediction in that cohort, not causal inference or clinical benefit.
ai_technology: LightGBM, XGBoost and other supervised classifiers
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Training and internal-validation waves plus an independent Tangshan 2020 cohort evaluated obesity classification under two growth standards.
evidence.unknown: External cohort prediction does not establish causal factors or clinical benefit; generalization beyond the studied Chinese cohorts is unknown.
evidence.ai_role: LightGBM, XGBoost and other supervised classifiers

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
